svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 60 wide x 190 long from 3 mm 5052 aluminium.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend 90 degrees 60 mm from one end: the short side is the upright

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: leg against the mast, the long side (130 mm) sticks out level.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two 9 mm holes 42 mm apart, 30 mm below the bend.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Level leg: one 12.2 mm hole on the centre line, 112 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside face of the upright leg, for the antenna's bulkhead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the bin side of the mast, 2.08 m up, on a V-saddle and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: U-bolt. The antenna's bulkhead goes through the level leg with its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: connector underneath; the whip stands up, 140 mm from the mast.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the whip stands upright and clear of the panel frame.
